name: study3_outpatient_blood_pressures
title: Blood pressures measured during outpatient visits
description: Systolic and diastolic blood pressure measurements recorded during outpatient (ambulatory) encounters

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

feature.name: codes
feature.title: LOINC codes for the blood pressure measurement
feature.description: LOINC codes for the blood pressure measurement

feature.name: joinTime
feature.title: Observation date shifted 3 days earlier
feature.description: The observation date shifted 3 days earlier. Used as the event time of this feature group so that measurements taken up to 3 days after the reference time point still fall inside the feature window, mirroring the late-registration allowance applied to the other study 3 features. This is not the time of the measurement - use effectiveDateTime for that.
